newsitem.title: INDIA: India soybean prices slide further; oil, meal down.
newsitem.headline: India soybean prices slide further; oil, meal down.

text.p: Soybean prices fell further by 400 rupees per tonne on Wednesday in central Indian markets on increased arrivals and limited purchases by processing plants, traders said.
Soybean prices have fallen by nearly 1,000 rupees per tonne in the last three days.
Soyoil prices too fell on heavy selling by processing plants and refining units. Soyoil solvent moved down by 300 rupees per tonne and soyoil refined by 400 rupees per tonne.

Soymeal and rapeseed extraction prices also fell sharply on limited export demand. Soymeal yellow was quoted at $265 per tonne for ready shipment and $263-265 per tonne for November-December shippment.
Rapeseed extraction was quoted at $118 per tonne for export. Rapeseed extraction was offered at 4,100 rupees per tonne FOR Bedibunder and at 4,150-4175 rupees per tonne FOR Bhavnagar.
Soyoil (in rupees per tonne) Soyoil solvent plant delivery 25,500-25,600
